nextStep.RESOLVED_ACCEPTED: Closed with a full refund to the trader. The effect shows on this shipment's payout.
nextStep.RESOLVED_PARTIAL: Closed with a partial refund. The effect shows on this shipment's payout.
nextStep.RESOLVED_REJECTED: Closed in your favour with no refund. Nothing is needed from you.
nextStep.RESOLVED_REPLACED: Closed with a replacement. Follow the replacement obligation.

respond.heading: Send your response
respond.descriptionHint: Explain your position clearly. This text is shown to the platform when the decision is made.
respond.prompt: A response cannot be withdrawn once sent. Continue?
respond.descriptionLength: The text must be between {min} and {max} characters.

replacements.title: Replacements
replacements.description: The replacements you owe, and the state of each one.
replacements.allHandled: Every replacement is in the section above.

awaiting.title: Waiting on you
awaiting.description: Replacements that have not shipped yet.

replacements.destinationNotice: A replacement goes to the same destination as the original shipment.

nextStep.AWAITING_PREPARATION: Begin preparing the replacement, then record it here.
nextStep.PREPARING: Finish preparing it, then mark it ready to ship.
nextStep.READY_TO_SHIP: Hand it to the carrier, then record the shipping details.
nextStep.SHIPPED: The replacement is on its way. The trader confirms receipt; nothing is needed from you now.
nextStep.DELIVERED: The replacement was delivered and the obligation is complete.
nextStep.FAILED: This replacement could not be completed. Contact support for the next steps.

settlements.title: Payouts
settlements.description: The transfers made to you, and how each one was calculated.
settlements.emptyDescription: No settlement has been made yet.
settlements.perShipmentNotice: Payouts are calculated per shipment, so an order delivered to several branches settles more than once.
settlements.basisNotice: These figures are frozen when the order is created and are never recalculated, which is what makes them reconcilable.
settlements.openOrder: Open the order and its documents

outcomeNextStep.EXECUTED: The amount was transferred to your recorded bank account.
outcomeNextStep.ZERO_BALANCE: Nothing was owed on this shipment and no amount was transferred. This is a correct outcome, not an error.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Updates on your orders, disputes and payouts.
notifications.emptyDescription: You have not received any notifications yet.
notifications.noDestination: There is no page linked to this notification.

type.ORDER_CREATED: A new order on your products
type.ALLOCATION_READY: A shipment is ready to ship
type.DISPUTE_OPENED: A dispute was raised on one of your shipments
type.REPLACEMENT_FAILED: A replacement could not be completed

unauthorized.title: Access not available
unauthorized.description: Your account cannot open this page.

states.errorDescription: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: The submitted data is not valid.
codes.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this item.
codes.CONFLICT: This conflicts with the item's current state.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The commercial registration number or password is incorrect.
codes.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Please verify your email address first.
codes.REGISTRATION_CONFLICT: Registration could not be completed with these details. If you already have an account, try signing in or recovering access.
codes.SUPPLIER_NOT_VERIFIED: The supplier account is not verified yet.
codes.TAXONOMY_CYCLE_DETECTED: A circular taxonomy cannot be created.
codes.SHIPPING_TARIFF_NOT_CONFIGURED: The shipping tariff is not configured.
codes.PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_ALREADY_ACTIVE: A payment attempt is already active.
codes.INVALID_FULFILLMENT_TRANSITION: That fulfilment transition is not allowed.
codes.PRODUCT_TECHNICAL_CHECK_FAILED: This product does not pass the automatic checks yet. Review the items listed, then try again.

nav.label: Admin navigation
nav.footerNote: Internal operations console. Every action here is written to the audit log.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.description: This area requires an administrator account with two-factor authentication.
login.verifyDescription: Enter the code shown in your authenticator app.
login.codeHint: Six digits, changing every thirty seconds.
login.recoveryHint: Each code works once and is then invalidated.
login.setupDescription: Add the key below to your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
login.setupSecretHint: Copy the key and enter it manually in the app.
login.setupRecoveryWarning: These codes are shown once and cannot be retrieved later. Save them somewhere safe — they are your only way back in if you lose your device.
login.setupSaved: I have saved these recovery codes somewhere safe.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: What is waiting on someone, first.
dashboard.twoFactorTitle: Your account has no two-factor authentication
dashboard.twoFactorDescription: This account signs in with a password alone. Enable two-factor from the admin accounts page.
dashboard.providerMode: Notification provider mode: {mode}. In a simulated mode nothing reaches anyone.
dashboard.noBacklog: No messages waiting to be sent.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Every registered company, and the supplier verification queue.
companies.approvePrompt: “{name}” will be verified and able to list and sell on the platform.
companies.rejectPrompt: Verification for “{name}” will be refused, and the written reason will reach the company.
companies.rejectReasonHint: The company receives this text and it is what they will act on to correct their application. At least five characters.
companies.emptyDescription: Try adjusting the search or filters.

products.title: Products
products.description: The review queue, then the whole catalogue.
products.name: Product
products.approvePrompt: “{name}” will be approved and can then be listed in opportunities.
products.rejectPrompt: “{name}” will be rejected, and the reason will be shown to the supplier on their own screen.
products.rejectReasonHint: The supplier reads this text and it is what they will fix before resubmitting. At least five characters.
products.cascadeHint: This may cascade to opportunities that list the product. At least five characters.
products.emptyDescription: Try adjusting the search or filters.

reports.title: Product reports
reports.description: Reports buyers have filed about listed products.
reports.noAutoActionNotice: Filing a report does not suspend or hide the product. Suspending or closing it is a separate, deliberate action on the products page.
reports.clarificationPrompt: The reporter will be asked for further detail.
reports.clarificationHint: The reporter reads this text. At least five characters.
reports.resolvePrompt: The report will be closed as resolved.
reports.resolveHint: The reporter reads this text. At least five characters.
reports.dismissPrompt: The report will be closed with no action taken on the product.
reports.dismissHint: The reporter reads this text and it is the only answer they receive. At least five characters.
reports.terminalNotice: This report is closed and takes no further decision.
reports.emptyDescription: Nothing has been filed under this filter.

opportunities.title: Opportunities
opportunities.description: Monitoring opportunities listed on the platform.
opportunities.monitorOnlyNotice: Administrators monitor opportunities; they do not create or edit them. Price, quantities and share terms belong to the supplier alone.
opportunities.pausePrompt: The opportunity will be paused and will stop accepting new buyers.
opportunities.pauseReasonHint: This text is shown to the supplier. At least five characters.
opportunities.resumePrompt: The opportunity will be listed again until the end of its window.
opportunities.cancelPrompt: Cancellation is permanent: the opportunity closes to any new purchase and every active hold in a buyer's basket is released.
opportunities.cancelReasonHint: This text is stored on the opportunity. At least five characters.
opportunities.actionRequiredNotice: This opportunity needs action from the supplier. An administrator cannot republish it on their behalf.
opportunities.noActionsAvailable: No action is available on this opportunity in its current state.
opportunities.cannotResumeExpired: This opportunity cannot be resumed because its listing window has ended.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Every paid order on the platform.
orders.confirmDeliveryPrompt: Delivery will be confirmed on the buyer's behalf, which starts the dispute window and the payout clock.
orders.confirmDeliveryReason: Reason for confirming on the buyer's behalf
orders.confirmDeliveryHint: Stored as the record of why the platform stepped in. At least five characters.
orders.settlePrompt: A settlement will be recorded for this shipment. The amount comes from the frozen financial snapshot and is not entered by hand.
orders.transferReferenceHint: Leave blank when there was no transfer — a zero-balance settlement has no reference.
orders.noInvoices: No invoice documents have been issued for this order yet.
orders.createProductDraftPrompt: A product invoice draft will be created for this order.
orders.createCommissionDraftPrompt: A commission invoice draft will be created for this order.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.description: Every dispute a buyer has opened on a delivered shipment.
disputes.noSupplierResponse: The supplier has not responded yet.
disputes.amountHint: Enter the amount with two decimal places, e.g. 125.50. The server checks each amount against the shipment's frozen financial snapshot.
disputes.replacementHint: Cannot exceed the shipment's original quantity.
disputes.reasonHint: Stored with the decision and visible to both parties. At least five characters.
disputes.waitingForSupplier: A decision cannot be issued before the supplier responds or their response deadline passes.
disputes.noFurtherDecision: This case takes no further decision.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Money owed back to buyers, and the attempts to send it.
refunds.providerHint: The list shows only the providers registered in this deployment.
refunds.noAttempts: No attempt has been made yet.
refunds.noProviders: No refund provider is registered in this deployment, so no attempt can be started.
refunds.noAttemptPossible: A new attempt cannot be started on an obligation that is completed or already in flight.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.perShipmentNotice: Settlement is per shipment, so an order delivered to three branches settles three times.

bankAccounts.title: Bank accounts
bankAccounts.description: Bank accounts submitted by suppliers for review.
bankAccounts.approvePrompt: This account becomes the payout destination for “{company}”, replacing any previously approved account.
bankAccounts.rejectPrompt: The bank account for “{company}” will be refused, and the reason will reach the supplier.
bankAccounts.rejectReasonHint: The supplier reads this and decides whether to resubmit with a different document or a different account. At least five characters.
bankAccounts.emptyDescription: Try adjusting the search or filters.

adminUsers.title: Admin accounts
adminUsers.description: Your account, and the rest of the administration team.
adminUsers.creationNotice: Administrator accounts cannot be created here. They are created with the bootstrap command on the server, so that one compromised session is never enough to mint a second permanent account.
adminUsers.disablePrompt: The account “{email}” will be disabled and its sessions ended.
adminUsers.disableHint: Written to the audit log. At least five characters.
adminUsers.enablePrompt: The account “{email}” will return to active.
adminUsers.enableHint: Written to the audit log. At least five characters.
adminUsers.resetPrompt: “{email}” will be asked to enrol a new authenticator app at their next sign-in.
adminUsers.resetHint: Usually because a device was lost. Written to the audit log. At least five characters.
adminUsers.signedOutElsewhere: Changing your password ends every other session you have on other devices.
adminUsers.regenerateWarning: New codes invalidate the current ones immediately, and any saved copy stops working. The new codes are shown once.
adminUsers.regeneratedWarning: Save them now. They cannot be shown again.
adminUsers.emptyDescription: Try adjusting the search or filters.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: What changed, who changed it, and why.
audit.scopeNotice: This log shows the event, its actor and its reason — not copies of the values before and after, and not request metadata such as network address. Viewing the log does not create an entry in it.

outbox.title: Notifications and integrations
outbox.description: Notification delivery state, and the state of external integrations.
outbox.providerMode: Notification provider mode: {mode}. In a simulated mode nothing reaches anyone.
outbox.publishedMeaning: “Accepted by provider” means the provider took the request, not that the message arrived. Delivery is at-least-once, not exactly-once.
outbox.healthNotice: No integration reports as healthy, because a real connectivity check has not been built yet. Showing a healthy status without testing would be an unverified claim.

catalogue.title: Reference data
catalogue.description: Categories, selling units, regions and cities.
catalogue.taxonomyHint: The categories products are filed under, and the ones offered for the site's top menu.
catalogue.salesUnitsHint: The units a product is sold by, such as carton or tonne.
catalogue.deactivatePrompt: This item will disappear from every picker. Records that already reference it are unchanged.
catalogue.notDeleteNotice: None of these can be deleted. Deactivating hides an item from the pickers without touching the records that point at it.

banners.title: Banners
banners.description: Promotional banners on the home page and the opportunities page.
banners.imageNotice: Banner images are uploaded through a separate endpoint with its own content-type and size checks, and are not managed from this page.
banners.linkHint: The server checks the link against an allowlist of hosts and refuses anything outside it.
banners.orderChanged: Order changed and not yet saved.
banners.scheduleHint: Leave a field blank to clear it. The server checks for overlap and for the limit on how many banners run at once.

branding.title: Brand and colours
branding.description: The site's name and description, and its brand colours.
branding.identityReadOnlyNotice: The name, description and logos are shown here for reference only. The logo fields are URLs that every visitor's browser loads and that are embedded in invoices and outgoing mail, so changing them stays an operational task with its own review.
branding.identityNotConfigured: Site identity has not been configured yet.
branding.themeHint: Saving a draft changes nothing for visitors. Publishing is what applies the colours to the site.
branding.issueFormat: {key}: the colour value is not valid.
branding.invalidHex: Enter a six-digit colour such as #0B1F33.
branding.publishPrompt: The draft colours will be applied to the site for every visitor.
branding.resetPrompt: The draft will be replaced with the defaults shipped with the system.

content.title: Site content
content.description: Home page wording and the categories in the top menu.
content.textOnlyNotice: Every value here is rendered as text only — no HTML and no Markdown. The menu is built from existing categories, so a destination cannot be typed by hand.
content.taxonomyUnavailable: Categories could not be loaded, so the top menu cannot be edited right now. The home page wording is still editable.
content.blankMeansDefault: A blank field means use the built-in wording shipped with the system — not show nothing.
content.navHint: Add up to eight categories and order them. Category names are read from the catalogue at render time, so renaming a category renames the menu item automatically.
content.navFull: The menu has reached its maximum number of categories.
content.navEmpty: No categories have been added to the top menu.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: General settings editable from this screen.
settings.scopeNotice: This is a short, explicit allow-list, not a window onto the settings table. Rate limits, session duration, tax, commission, shipping tariffs, payment and fulfilment each have their own endpoint with its own bounds and review, and are not edited here.
settings.readOnly: This setting is read-only and cannot be changed through the console.
settings.editElsewhere: Edited on the site content page
settings.emptyDescription: No setting is registered in the allow-list.

invoicing.title: Invoicing
invoicing.description: The platform's own legal details, used on documents.
invoicing.notConfiguredDescription: No invoice document can be issued until the platform's legal details are recorded.
invoicing.versioningNotice: The billing profile is versioned, never edited. A change creates a new version and earlier ones stay exactly as they were, because documents already issued were computed against them and must remain reproducible.
invoicing.draftsDescription: Invoice drafts are raised per order, from the order's own page.
